`interface INode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`IIndexedElement`](/reference/utilities/iindexedelement/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [INode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/INode.java)

The hooks that JOID calls on a node, all empty by default, that a node of your own overrides.

## Description

[`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/) implements it; override only the hooks you need, and call `super` to keep the behavior of a built-in node.
Every hook runs on the render thread.

## Learn more

- [Custom nodes](/use/learn/going-further/custom-nodes/#override-the-hooks-you-need)

## Method details

<a id="INode-method-init"></a>

### init

`void init(UI ui)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Called when the node is loaded into a UI, after its children and its effects and before `onInit`.

<a id="INode-method-update"></a>

### update

`void update()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Called on every frame, after the children are updated and before the node is drawn.
Measure a size that depends on the content here, so that a layout node sees it on the same frame.

<a id="INode-method-layout"></a>

### layout

`void layout()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Called on every frame, after the node is placed and before its children are drawn: place the children and the parts here with `layoutPosition` and `layoutSize`.

<a id="INode-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw(double mouseX, double mouseY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Draws the node at `getX()`, `getY()`, with the mouse at this point of the canvas, once it is mounted.

<a id="INode-method-drawSkeleton"></a>

### drawSkeleton

`void drawSkeleton(double mouseX, double mouseY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Draws the node in place of `draw` while one of its `wait` conditions fails and it has no skeleton node.

<a id="INode-method-mousePressed"></a>

### mousePressed

`void mousePressed(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Called when a mouse press reaches the node, after its `handleMousePressed` listeners.
The event can already be consumed: check it before acting.

<a id="INode-method-detach"></a>

### detach

`void detach()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

Called when the node leaves its UI, after its children: release here what `init` started.
A `detach` that throws prints a warning, and the node is detached anyway.
